reviews.quote:
I recently used a Groupon for Balayage Me Hair Salon, and I finally went in yesterday. I ended up having the best experience. My stylist, Firuza, was professional, attentive, and incredibly talented. I had my roots done, a full balayage, a wash, blow dry, and cut.

Although I wasn’t able to receive every service listed on my Groupon, David worked everything out with me — thank you, David.

I was there for a few hours, but the time went by quickly because every step was so well coordinated. They offered me coffee, and the environment was great.  I’ll definitely be returning.
reviews.author: Raquel

reviews.quote: I called to make an appointment. They had an immediate availability for one hour from the time I called which worked out for my schedule for the day. I was a few minutes tardy but they were still able to accommodate me right away. Showed my Groupon and they accepted it. They came up with a game plan for my hair,  sat me in the chair & worked their magic. I LOVE my end results. I am appreciative. Thanks again!

faqs.question: What deal options are available at Balayage Me Hair Salon for cut and color services?
faqs.answer: Balayage Me Hair Salon offers six deal options: Partial Balayage with Toner and Blow-Dry; Haircut with Partial Highlights or Balayage, Olaplex Treatment, Toner, and Blow-Dry; Root Touch-Up with Blow-Dry; Haircut with Olaplex Treatment and Blow-Dry; a Two-Pack of Haircut with Olaplex Treatment and Blow-Dry for one person; and a Holiday Special featuring Full Head Highlights or Balayage with Olaplex Treatment, Toner, and Blow-Dry.

faqs.question: Where is Balayage Me Hair Salon located in New York, NY?
faqs.answer: Balayage Me Hair Salon is located at 210 East 21st Street in the Gramercy Park neighborhood of New York, NY 10010.

faqs.question: Does the Transform your look with a stylish cut and color services deal include Olaplex treatments?
faqs.answer: Yes, several of the deal options under Transform your look with a stylish cut and color services include an Olaplex Treatment, specifically the Haircut with Partial Highlights or Balayage option, the Haircut with Olaplex Treatment and Blow-Dry option, the Two-Pack option, and the Holiday Special.

faqs.question: Is there a multi-session option available at Balayage Me Hair Salon?
faqs.answer: Yes, Balayage Me Hair Salon offers a Two-Pack deal option consisting of a Haircut with Olaplex Treatment and Blow-Dry for one person, allowing the same individual to use the service twice.
